official.application_cycle: 2027 intake (the scholarship is in place for 2027-2029 intakes)
official.status_note: The official page is live for students starting in 2027: 'If you're looking to start studying in 2027, you could receive up to 20% off your tuition fees for the entire duration of your eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course.'
official.tuition_coverage_note: For 2027 starters the award is a percentage tuition fee discount: minimum equivalent ATAR 85.00 for 10% off tuition fees and minimum ATAR 90.00 for 20% off (undergraduate); minimum WAM 65.00 for 10% off and minimum WAM 75.00 for 20% off (postgraduate).
benefits: Up to 20% off tuition fees for the entire duration of your eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course (2027 starters)
Annual tuition fee discount for the normal full-time duration of the awardee's course as specified in their letter of offer
The value of the scholarship is determined by the applicant's equivalent ATAR or UWA weighted average mark (WAM)
If deferred to 2028 the scholarship is retained: the award is in place for 2027-2029 intakes
eligibility: Students from all countries are eligible
Received an offer for an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate course for 2027 at The University of Western Australia
Undergraduate: applying for an eligible undergraduate course, combined bachelor's degree, combined bachelor's and master's degree, or Assured Pathway course
Postgraduate: applying for an eligible postgraduate course
International and overseas qualifications achieved at a certain level make you eligible; other programs or qualifications are considered on an individual basis
requirements: Eligibility can only be assessed once final academic transcripts are received; conditional offers may be issued without the scholarship attached
The scholarship may not be held concurrently with any other UWA issued tuition fee reduction, academic scholarship or award
Criteria for continuation are set out in clause 13 'Criteria for Continuation' of the full terms and conditions
Undergraduate exclusions: Assured Pathway to Medicine; Assured Pathway to Dental Medicine
Postgraduate exclusions: Juris Doctor (20820), Doctor of Medicine (91850), Doctor of Dental Medicine (91860), Doctor of Optometry (91590), UWA Micro-credentials
documents: Application to the chosen UWA course
Final academic transcripts (required before the scholarship can be assessed)
selection_criteria: Equivalent ATAR 85.00 for 10% off tuition fees; equivalent ATAR 90.00 for 20% off (undergraduate)
WAM 65.00 for 10% off tuition fees; WAM 75.00 for 20% off (postgraduate)
The scholarship is automatically awarded to those who are eligible based on ATAR/WAM requirements
coverage: 10-20% tuition fee discount applied per semester, for the normal full-time duration of the course
application_method: No separate scholarship application; submit an application to the chosen course and Admissions assesses eligibility once final transcripts are provided
official.application_route: Apply for an eligible 2027 course and ensure final academic transcripts are submitted; the scholarship is then automatic and shown in the offer letter or a scholarship contract.
official.citizenship_residency: No country restriction - students from all countries are eligible
official.international_eligibility: Offered to high-achieving international students from across the globe; international and overseas qualifications are assessed for equivalence
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Excluded courses apply (e.g. Assured Pathway to Medicine and Dental Medicine for undergraduates; Juris Doctor, Doctor of Medicine, Doctor of Dental Medicine, Doctor of Optometry and UWA Micro-credentials for postgraduates)
official.duration: The normal full-time duration of the awardee's course as specified in their letter of offer
official.description: The Global Excellence Scholarship is UWA's automatic award for high-achieving international students from across the globe: an annual tuition fee discount for the normal full-time duration of the course, with the value set by equivalent ATAR or WAM. For 2027 starters it offers up to 20 per cent off tuition fees, and it is in place for 2027-2029 intakes.
official.program_type: Automatic excellence-based tuition fee discount (undergraduate and postgraduate coursework)

verification.notes: The official UWA scholarship page and full terms and conditions link were fetched directly. The current 2027 terms are expressed as percentage discounts (10%/20%), not the fixed AUD amounts quoted for earlier intakes, so no monetary award amount is recorded.

applicant_utility.summary: UWA's Global Excellence Scholarship is automatic once your final transcripts land, but the value is decided by a narrow ATAR/WAM ladder: 85.00 buys 10 per cent off, 90.00 buys 20 per cent off (WAM 65.00 and 75.00 for postgraduates). There is no application and no deadline, which means the award is won or lost in the course application itself. Watch the exclusions: Assured Pathways to Medicine and Dental Medicine, the Juris Doctor, MD, Dental Medicine, Optometry and Micro-credentials are all outside the scheme.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Strong-but-not-elite applicants (around the 85-90 ATAR or 65-75 WAM band) who want a meaningful discount without a separate scholarship application
application_readiness_checklist: Get final transcripts in early: Admissions cannot assess the scholarship on predicted or incomplete results
Map your qualification to its equivalent ATAR/WAM using UWA's entry standards before relying on a 20 per cent assumption
Check your course code against the exclusion list before applying, especially professional health and law programmes
If you already hold a UWA award such as the International Student Award, expect Admissions to award only the single highest-value scholarship
Read clause 13 of the terms and conditions for the continuation criteria before accepting
common_rejection_risks: Accepting a conditional offer before final transcripts arrive and assuming the scholarship is locked in
Enrolling in an excluded course, where even a 99 ATAR earns nothing
Holding another UWA tuition reduction, which bars concurrent holding of the Global Excellence award
Crediting a third-party site's older AUD 12,000-per-year figure, which the current page no longer publishes
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: With a 10-20 per cent discount, the remaining 80-90 per cent of tuition plus all living and travel costs must be met from other funds.
document_audit: The final academic transcript is the only scholarship-critical document; sloppy or late transcript submission is the most common cause of a missing award
If accepted onto a conditional offer, follow up with Admissions in writing once final results are released to trigger reassessment
alerts: The award is confirmed for 2027-2029 intakes, so deferring from 2027 to 2028 keeps the scholarship
The current page publishes percentages, not dollar amounts: older figures like AUD 12,000 per year are from previous cycles and should not be relied on
An offer for health and medical sciences courses triggers compulsory health and legal screening requirements, which are independent of the scholarship
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Apply for the 2027 course, submit final transcripts, and let Admissions assess automatically; the award appears in the offer letter or arrives later as a scholarship contract.
